# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.95

This release expands the in-game tutorial with illustrated, step-by-step guides
for Buddy Rush clubs, the Buddy Bus, city buses, and earning coins through work.

## Illustrated tutorial

- Added a colourful clubhouse guide showing recruitment, clubhouse activities,
  Friendship Badge defence, and travel to rival clubs.
- Added a roadside Buddy Bus guide explaining how to visit the stop, challenge
  rotating visitors, wait safely on the pavement, and recognise the moving red
  and blue double-decker buses.
- Added a workplace guide showing Buddy Market, Sunny Bites, Buddy Delivery, and
  Sunshine Farm plus the three-task route from starting a shift to earning
  wages, tips, and mastery.
- Added concise task examples for Shopkeeper, Restaurant, Delivery, and Farming
  shifts.
- Clarified that Delivery Shift is a job while Delivery Dash is a separate Mini
  Game with its own coin rewards.

## Guided actions

- Added tutorial buttons that open Buddy Rush, locate the Buddy Bus Stop on Town
  Map, or open Jobs & Work directly.
- Preserved the existing control, multiplayer, messaging, building, map,
  mini-game, vehicle, and saving guides below the new featured walkthroughs.
- Kept the tutorial panel touch-friendly and scrollable on narrow portrait
  screens with accessible descriptions for every illustration.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
